title: $25.5 million in legal fees: The law firms behind SpaceX’s $75 billion IPO
description: SpaceX’s $75 billion initial public offering (IPO) went through without the company naming a General Counsel in its filings.SpaceX disclosed legal fees and expenses of $25.5 million in connection with the offering.
